items.title: Atomic Chat 2.4.6 ships Strata, a built-in desktop runtime for running models locally
items.summary: The release adds Strata as the app's own local runtime, with detection of Apple Silicon, so local models run without a separate runtime install.

items.title: TensorFold adds a recipe catalog of deployable containers for local model serving
items.summary: TensorFold's website now lists ready-to-deploy container recipes, so local inference setups can be started from a catalog entry.

items.title: OXR vision model now runs on Macs via mlx-vlm, in the browser via WebAssembly, and on its own inference server
items.summary: Community ports of the open-sourced OXR model include MLX BF16 and 8-bit weights with an mlx-vlm pull request, a WebAssembly build with a Hugging Face Space demo (about 1.4 GB first load), and a standalone inference repo.

items.title: Epoch AI: agentic inference capacity grew 4.6x in a year versus 2.6x for compute
items.summary: Epoch's Inference Performance Index puts the Q2 2025 to Q2 2026 growth of capacity usable for agentic inference at 4.6x, with Nvidia Blackwell generations accounting for 74% of added capacity. The Data Insight page gives the methodology.

items.title: Exa Websets V2: faster, cheaper web dataset building with pay-as-you-go API access
items.summary: Websets V2 is live for all users, claimed 4x faster and 2x cheaper per result with 20% higher accuracy and recall on company and people list-building evals, now with usage-based pricing and API access.

doubt.pushback: Speed, cost and accuracy figures come from Exa's own evals; no independent check seen.

items.title: Omarchy next update: 197 changes including Omaview media viewer, plus GPU memory change for local models on AMD Strix Halo
items.summary: The weekly roundup lists Omaview replacing imv and mpv, a separable icon set and bundled games; a separate change lets AMD Strix Halo GPUs address more RAM for local models.

items.title: fal launches Idol Max and Idol Max Turbo: image-to-3D with real GLB meshes, UVs, 2K textures, optional PBR and auto-rig
items.summary: One image in, a game-ready textured mesh out (not a Gaussian splat), hosted on fal with a faster Turbo variant. Game and 3D pipeline builders get riggable assets from a single image.

doubt.pushback: Two repliers who compared it with Tripo3D and Meshy said results looked worse; no side-by-side shown.

reception.summary: Most replies praise one-image-to-game-asset output; two repliers say a side test against Tripo3D or Meshy came out worse and one asks about topology and retopo quality.

items.title: Home-lab test: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next with 16 streams gives 1,092 tok/s on one RTX PRO 6000 versus 453 tok/s reported for an M5 Ultra 256GB
items.summary: A measured comparison with per-stream numbers (258 tok/s single stream, about 68 per stream at 16, card capped at 350W) and a note that the two sets use different workloads. Raw results are in a linked repo.
